title: Nowhere To Be. Hoodie
descriptionHtml:
No shift, no schedule, nobody waiting on you.

For the couch or the long way home.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Left chest: NOWHERE TO BE., embroidered on two lines, about 68 mm (2.7 in) wide
  • Styles: Oversized or Garment-Dyed
  • Oversized: relaxed fit, dropped shoulders. 80% cotton, 20% recycled polyester fleece, 9.4 oz/yd² (319 g/m²). Lined hood with no drawcord, front kangaroo pocket
  • Garment-Dyed: relaxed fit. 80% ring-spun cotton, 20% polyester, 9.5 oz/yd² (322 g/m²), garment-dyed after sewing

Which size? See Size & fit.
seoTitle: Nowhere To Be. Embroidered Hoodie | OFF SHFT
seoDescription: No shift, no schedule, nobody waiting on you. Nowhere To Be., embroidered on a hoodie made to order. For the couch or the long way home.

styleNotes.Oversized: Relaxed fit with dropped shoulders, in 80% cotton, 20% recycled polyester fleece, 9.4 oz/yd² (319 g/m²), with a lined hood and no drawcord.
styleNotes.Garment-Dyed: Relaxed fit in 80% ring-spun cotton, 20% polyester, 9.5 oz/yd² (322 g/m²), garment-dyed after sewing.

toConfirm: Before ordering samples, open the 2012 US record for NOWHERE TO BE (serial 85784193) on USPTO: it looks like a dead clerical entry. Then search the phrase on USPTO and CIPO for clothing. So far it's web search only (designs/phrases/notes.md). Also search the exact phrase on Etsy, Amazon and Google Images (DESIGNS.md).
Never shorten it to NOWHERE: one company's NOWHERE mark covers hats and caps (search snippet only).

The three sweatpants listings say 'Nowhere to be and all day to get there.', and the Punched Out. sweatpants' meta description does too. So do the Sweats collection's description and meta description, if they went live as written in store/apparel-copy.md. Change that line now that it's a design, so they don't repeat this one. Check the live text before changing it. It's live, so it's your OK.

No production art yet: the size here is from the quick preview (designs/phrases/previews/sizes.json). It needs its own build and checks before digitizing, like designs/09-punched-out/v3. Update the size on the listing if it changes.
Get a sew-out on both styles before selling. Samples and Printful's digitizing (US$6.50 per new design) cost money, so it's your call.

Colours come later: you add them. Thread colours follow the fabric, once a sew-out on the real blank passes. Then each style gets linked to its Printful product and embroidery file, or orders won't reach Printful.
The Lightweight hoodie (1467) is left out until Printful confirms it embroiders the left chest. If it does, add it as a third style with its style note from store/products/drop1.json.
Still open from the first-drop hoodies (store/products/drop1.json): care instructions for each style and Printful's production time with embroidery.

title: Sun’s Still Up. Hat
descriptionHtml:
You're off work and there's still daylight left.

For a line in the water or a quick nine before dark.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Front: SUN’S STILL UP., embroidered on two lines, about 60 mm (2.4 in) wide
  • Styles: 5-Panel or Rope Cap
  • 5-Panel: structured mid-profile cap. One-piece front with no centre seam, 65% polyester and 35% cotton twill, adjustable plastic snap closure

Fit questions? See Size & fit.
seoTitle: Sun’s Still Up. Embroidered Hat | OFF SHFT
seoDescription: You're off work and there's still daylight left. Sun’s Still Up., embroidered on a hat made to order. For a line in the water or a quick nine.

styleNotes.5-Panel: Structured mid-profile cap in 65% polyester, 35% cotton twill, with a one-piece front (no centre seam) and an adjustable plastic snap closure.

toConfirm: Before ordering samples, search SUN'S STILL UP, with and without the apostrophe, on USPTO and CIPO for clothing and hats. The nearest filing found is SUN'S OUT, BUNS OUT (US Reg. 4544740). So far it's web search only (designs/phrases/notes.md). Also search the exact phrase on Etsy, Amazon and Google Images (DESIGNS.md).
Keep the curly apostrophe (’) in the art, the title and the copy. Without an apostrophe, the line reads like a sports score.
It's a summer line (designs/phrases/notes.md: Victoria Day to Labour Day; in December it's dark before 5). Your call whether it shows over the winter or waits for May.

No production art yet: the size here is from the quick preview (designs/phrases/previews/sizes.json). It needs its own build and checks before digitizing, like designs/09-punched-out/v3, including the S trims. Update the size on the listing if it changes.

Get a sew-out on both styles before selling. The apostrophe and the S's are the small parts to watch, and Printful reviews of the Rope Cap mention wrinkling and stitches through the lining. Samples and Printful's digitizing (US$6.50 per new design) cost money, so it's your call.

The Rope Cap's front embroidery area wasn't found: check its File guidelines tab. The stack is about the logo's size (60 x 18 mm). Both fronts are seamless (Printful lists the Rope Cap as 5-panel with a lined front panel: store/previews/items/rope-cap.cjs), so it stays centred on each.

Colours come later: you add them. Thread colours follow the fabric, once a sew-out on the real blank passes. Then each style gets linked to its Printful product and embroidery file, or orders won't reach Printful.
Still open from the first-drop hats (store/products/drop1.json): care for each style, and the Rope Cap's material, profile and closure from Printful's spec sheet, for a Details line of its own.

title: Banked Time. Hat
descriptionHtml:
The overtime you saved up, taken as days off.

For a long stretch at the cottage or on the water.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Front: BANKED TIME., embroidered on one line, about 96 mm (3.8 in) wide
  • Styles: Dad Hat or Retro Trucker
  • Retro Trucker: structured six-panel cap. Hard buckram front, mesh back, pre-curved visor, adjustable plastic snap closure

Fit questions? See Size & fit.
seoTitle: Banked Time. Embroidered Hat | OFF SHFT
seoDescription: The overtime you saved up, taken as days off. Banked Time., embroidered on a hat made to order. For a long stretch at the cottage.

styleNotes.Retro Trucker: Structured six-panel cap with a hard buckram front, mesh back and adjustable plastic snap closure.

toConfirm: Before ordering samples, search BANKED TIME on USPTO and CIPO for clothing and hats. The nearest filing found, TIME BANK (US serial 87358423), is for financial services. So far it's web search only (designs/phrases/notes.md). Also search the exact phrase on Etsy, Amazon and Google Images (DESIGNS.md).

The Retro Trucker has a seam down the middle of the front (the Dad Hat too, if it's six-panel), so the line moves sideways to put the seam in a gap. In the word space (4.9 mm) the line would sit 9.3 mm left of centre, and Punched Out.'s build allows at most 6 mm before a line looks off-centre. In the gap between the E and the D it moves only 1.94 mm right, but that gap is 2.24 mm, narrower than the 2.4 mm one Punched Out. uses. The production art picks one, and the sew-out checks it. As with the logo, it isn't confirmed that Printful keeps an offset: check its editor and the sample.

The Dad Hat's six-panel build isn't confirmed from Printful yet: only the logo notes' general rule (store/products/drop1.json) and the preview drawing (store/previews/items/dad-hat.cjs) say six-panel. Confirm it before the line moves on that style.

No production art yet: the size here is from the quick preview (designs/phrases/previews/sizes.json). It needs its own build and checks before digitizing, like designs/09-punched-out/v3. Update the size on the listing if it changes.
Get a sew-out on both styles before selling, with the seam where the art puts it. Samples and Printful's digitizing (US$6.50 per new design) cost money, so it's your call.

Colours come later: you add them. Thread colours follow the fabric, once a sew-out on the real blank passes. Then each style gets linked to its Printful product and embroidery file, or orders won't reach Printful.

Still open from the first-drop hats (store/products/drop1.json): care for each style; the Dad Hat's material, profile and closure from Printful's spec sheet, for a Details line of its own; and the trucker's fabric, left out because the maker is changing the blend, so stock may be mixed.
